selector.rationale: The abdominal ultrasonography and contrast-enhanced CT findings of a thick-walled, predominantly anechoic lesion with low-level internal echoes and a homogeneous echogenic area, along with the presence of turbid fluid upon aspiration, support the diagnosis of an infected non-parasitic cyst.

rejected.label: Simple Hepatic Cyst
rejected.why: The presence of infection and turbid fluid upon aspiration contradicts the diagnosis of a simple hepatic cyst.

rejected.label: Infected Hepatic Cyst
rejected.why: While similar, the term 'infected hepatic cyst' is less specific than 'infected non-parasitic cyst', which is directly supported by imaging findings.

rejected.label: Pyogenic liver abscess
rejected.why: The imaging characteristics and clinical presentation, including the presence of a thick-walled, predominantly anechoic lesion, are more consistent with an infected cyst than a pyogenic liver abscess.
